method: Parsed evidence/trifusion_v20_q1_seed42_3cea5bf.json and all six endpoint receipt JSON files.
Verified each standalone endpoint receipt object equals the corresponding embedded endpoint object in the Q1 summary.
Rebuilt query masks from gallery_manifest identity and camera labels using counts[identity] > camera_counts[(identity,camera)].
Recomputed each fold/endpoint/output mAP as mean(average_precision)*100 and Rank-k as mean(first_match_rank <= k)*100.
Aggregated all 571 eligible queries across folds for each endpoint/output.
Computed matched mAP gains as candidate aggregate minus control aggregate.
Recomputed fold fused gains from per-fold fused AP arrays.
Recomputed 21-identity cluster bootstrap with NumPy default_rng(42), 10000 resamples, sampling whole identity clusters with replacement using cluster sums and sizes.
Recomputed scientific checks from the fixed gate definitions.

limitations: No training, inference, remote command, checkpoint tensor load, image read, feature extraction, distance recomputation, download, or network call was performed.

AP internals were not recomputed from distance matrices because distance replay and feature extraction were excluded; metrics were recomputed from recorded AP/rank arrays and masks were rebuilt from gallery_manifest labels/cameras.
V12 source checkpoints, CLIP weights, final Q1 checkpoints, raw data, and the remote CUDA/source filesystem are receipt-bound rather than independently possessed locally.
Two source/protocol files match recorded source bindings only after LF normalization, not as current local raw bytes.
Four terminal sidecars changed local raw hashes during the audit window; current links are coherent after re-read, but this prevents a clean provenance pass.
This reused train-internal OOF evaluation is not independent dev, official test, D1, or SOTA evidence.
